cwd.description: The working directory the checks used.

problems.description: Everything that would stop a run, per provider where it is about one.

ready.description:
Whether a run can go ahead: at least one provider is ready and no
problem is about the whole system. The exit status is 0 when it is true
and 1 when it is false.

skills.description: The skills built into this executable.

oneOf.description: Only runs that grant exact commands (`permissions.commands`).
Runs still start, but each would report its cleanup as not confirmed.

CommandHook.description:
Whether the Claude Code version has the blocking hook interface that exact
command grants need.

available.description:
Whether the installed version is that release or later, as a run
decides it.

required_version.description: The oldest release that has it.

DenyFile.description: A settings file that was read, and how many deny rules it held.

rules.description: The rules in the file, before deduplication.

DenyInfo.description:
The deny rules a Claude run would apply, as a run's notes give them: files
and counts, never a rule.

applied.description: Rules a worker would receive, after deduplication.

files.description: The settings files that exist and were read, with their rule counts.

skipped.description: Existing local settings files that would be ignored, with the reason.

EnvCounts.description:
How many environment variables a worker would receive, by reason. No names
and no values.

base.description: Of the caller's: base variables (user, shell, locale and the like).

network.description: Of the caller's: proxy and certificate settings.

passed.description: Variables the worker would receive in all.

provider.description: Of the caller's: variables that belong to the provider.

set_by_delega.description: Variables delega sets itself for this provider.

withheld.description: Variables of the caller's environment that would not be passed.

Limits.description: The limits in force, from the constants the code uses.

ProcessInspection.description: Whether the process listing that confirms cleanup works.

available.description: Whether one listing, run now as cleanup runs it, gave a usable table.

detail.description: Why not, when it is not available. Free text; it names no process.

Provider.description: The provider CLI that runs the assignment.

ProviderCheck.description: What was found for one provider.

command_hook.description:
For Claude Code, whether the command hook interface is available. Null
for Codex, which has no minimum version.

deny_rules.description:
The deny rules a Claude run would apply. Null for Codex, which reads
none, and when the launch could not be built.

env.description:
The environment a worker would get, or null when the launch could not be
built.

executable.description: The executable a run would use, or null when none was found.

executable_source.description: Where the lookup found it: the override variable's name, or `PATH`.

ready.description: Whether no problem stops every run with this provider.

version.description: The first line of `--version` output, or null when there was none.

ReportedProblem.description: A problem, with the provider it is about.

blocks.description:
What the problem stops: `run` (every run with the provider),
`command_grants` (only runs that grant exact commands) or `cleanup`
(runs start, but cleanup cannot be confirmed).

provider.description: The provider it is about, or null when it is about the whole system.

RunLimits.description: The defaults and bounds a single run has.

default_timeout_secs.description: The time limit when a request sets none, in seconds.

max_output_bytes.description: Most bytes of provider standard output kept.

max_stderr_bytes.description: Most bytes of provider standard error kept.

max_timeout_secs.description: The longest time limit a request may set, in seconds.

min_timeout_secs.description: The shortest time limit a request may set, in seconds.

version_probe_timeout_secs.description: How long the `--version` probe may take, in seconds.

SkillDigest.description: A packaged skill and its digest, as `delega version --output json` lists it.

digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of its text.

uri.description: Where an MCP client reads it.

SkippedFile.description: A local settings file that was not read, and why.

SupervisorLimits.description: The limits of the supervisor that serves the MCP tools.

default_wait_secs.description: The timeout `wait` uses when it gets none, in seconds.

max_outstanding_request_checks.description: Request checks that may be outstanding at once.

max_queued_per_worker.description: Runs waiting behind one worker's running run.

retained_bytes.description: Estimated bytes of finished results kept readable.

retention_secs.description: How long a finished result stays readable, in seconds.

wait_ceiling_secs.description: The longest one `wait` blocks, in seconds.
